title: L5-S1 facet force under 650 N compression + 550 N anterior shear in imposed postures (intact)
condition: intact (capsule cut 10 mm laterally for sensor)

quantity.name: facet force
quantity.definition: compressive force through a facet joint from a Flexiforce A101-500 sensor; FE: average of left and right; LB: facet analysed relative to bending direction (+ = bending toward it). Mean and SE per intact group (n=6 each), digitised; pooled n=12 derived

source.authors: Rousseau MA, Bradford DS, Bertagnoli R, Hu SS, Lotz JC
source.sample: 12 human cadaveric L5-S1 joints, radiographically normal (no disc degeneration or facet arthritis); intact tests before ProDisc II (n=6) or Charite III (n=6)

protocol.summary: S1 rigidly fixed with the disc at 40 deg to the load axis (sacral slope); 850 N vertical force at 20 N/min through a frictionless surface -> 650 N disc compression + 550 N anterior shear; L5 free to translate on the oblique frictionless plane, axial rotation free; wedges impose 0, 3, 6 deg flexion/extension or lateral bending (moments variable). Preconditioning 10 cycles in neutral; data after 2 min at each posture. Axial rotation of the plane adjusted at start to balance left/right facet forces.
how_to_simulate: Model L5-S1; fix S1 with its end plate inclined 40 deg to vertical load
Apply 650 N compression normal to the disc and 550 N anterior shear on L5 (or 850 N vertical on the 40 deg plane), L5 free to translate in the disc plane
Impose 0 or 6 deg of flexion, extension or lateral bending on L5
Report facet compressive force: mean of both facets in FE; in LB the facet on the bending side (+6) and the opposite facet (-6)
protocol.notes: Fig. 4 shows intact bars separately for the two groups (averages and standard errors). Neutral was measured in both the FE and LB series (different values). Sign convention of LB inferred from the methods ('left and right facet forces were analysed relative to the bending direction') and the Charite result 'increase to the side of the bending' at +6 deg. 3 deg postures not digitised. Implant data outside card scope.

extraction.check_notes: Review values do not match a consistent subset of Fig. 4: its SDs are SEs (n=6), its means mix groups/postures (ext 54.1 ~ 3 deg ext; flex 43.9 ~ Charite 3-6 deg flex), and its lateral-bending signs are reversed (+6: 20.7, -6: 58.4) vs the figure (+6 ~52, -6 ~21). Card now uses pooled intact n=12 values at 6 deg and neutral (FE series for neutral).
